snippet.title: Deadzone Rogue 2 - Official Playtest Trailer
snippet.description: Here's your look at action-packed gameplay from Deadzone: Rogue 2 in this trailer for the upcoming FPS roguelite adventure set on a fallen Earth. Fight as Talon 13-10 in Deadzone: Rogue 2. Combine weapons, augments, and elements to forge devastating builds, and blast through Monarch’s endless machines. Grow stronger each run, solo or with friends. Deadzone Rogue 2 will be available on PC via Steam. The Deadzone: Rogue 2 Playtest opens August 20 and runs through August 23 on Steam. To join, you can sign up on Deadzone Rogue 2 Steam's page and click the 'Request Access' button. You can play solo or with friends, in a squad of up to 3 players.
